concept: Проверка v3: тени, приглушённые фоны и пары цветов, размер в кат. 1

cards.label: Pocket Watch
cards.object: pocket watch with an open lid and a short chain
cards.key_features: a round case with an open hinged lid, a cream white face with simple dots instead of numbers, two hands, a winding crown with a chain
cards.pose: The watch is tilted diagonally, chain curling toward the lower left

cards.label: Gold Buckle
cards.key_features: a big oval plate with a raised horseshoe emblem in the middle, a rope-like rim, no text
cards.pose: The buckle is tilted diagonally, seen slightly from above

cards.label: Blue Ribbon
cards.key_features: a round pleated rosette with two ribbon tails hanging down, a plain round golden center with no text or number
cards.pose: The rosette is tilted diagonally, tails swinging to the lower left

cards.label: Lantern
cards.key_features: a glass chimney with wire guards, a round brass base, a carrying handle on top

cards.label: Honky-Tonk
cards.story_detail: a lit candle in a small brass holder standing on top
cards.key_features: a row of white piano keys with small black keys, an open music stand, two short carved front legs
cards.pose: The piano is turned in 3/4 view with the keyboard toward the viewer; we look very slightly up at it

cards.label: Mine Cart
cards.object: wooden mine cart heaped with gold nuggets
cards.scene: warm orange rocky cliffs with a timber-framed mine entrance
cards.story_detail: a heap of glittering gold nuggets
cards.key_features: a box-shaped cart on small wheels standing on rails that curve out of the mine entrance
cards.pose: The cart rolls toward the viewer along the curving rails, big in the foreground; the mine entrance behind
